senses.gloss: (to mark; to calculate, settle, strike the balance. Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ bot.; Y. Sot. V, 20ᶜ bot. (expl. פרוש קיזי) עביד … ומְקַזֵּז חדא עם חדא he commits one sin and does one good deed, and strikes the balance, ‘one against one.’ Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ bot. דהוות ציימא … ומְקַזָּה ליה תריי she used to fast one day and mark down two (deceiving herself in her account with God).
